title: Be Occt Brep Kernel Bridge
scope: Adapter OCCT, BRep, NURBS evaluation, tolerances, memory ownership/FFI safety.

runtime_implementation.boolean_two_ui_worker_2026_11_14: MatrixApp Boolean Two Objects prepares all preview modes from captured sources on admitted workers, retaining old preview until replacement; scoped headless tests pass. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-boolean-two-ui-worker.md
runtime_implementation.boolean_split_ui_worker_2026_11_14: MatrixApp Boolean Split runs captured source and multi-set partition on admitted workers with guarded publication in scoped headless tests. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-boolean-split-ui-worker.md
runtime_implementation.split_captured_source_2026_11_14: Source-only split and admitted piece extraction have scoped detached worker and kernel fixtures; product multi-set Split is not yet integrated. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-split-captured-source.md
runtime_implementation.boolean_binary_ui_worker_2026_11_14: MatrixApp Difference and Intersection source groups use admitted workers and guarded publication in scoped headless tests; Split and Two Objects remain synchronous. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-boolean-binary-ui-worker.md
runtime_implementation.boolean_union_ui_worker_2026_11_14: MatrixApp Boolean Union menu/CMD runs captured sources and placements on an admitted worker; context and transaction checks pass in scoped headless fixtures. Other Boolean routes and C1-C5 remain open. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-boolean-union-ui-worker.md
runtime_implementation.captured_boolean_placement_2026_11_14: Captured-source transformation and placed two-input Boolean have scoped worker, admission and placement checks; product Boolean commands are not integrated. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-boolean-captured-source.md#captured-placement-preparation
runtime_implementation.boolean_live_inputs_2026_11_14: Checked Boolean accounts both retained input allocations before canonical validation and output admission; product worker integration remains open. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-boolean-captured-source.md#live-input-memory-for-synchronous-boolean
runtime_implementation.captured_boolean_source_2026_11_14: Captured-source Boolean worker foundation passes scoped source/display lifetime and admission tests; product menu/CMD remains synchronous. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-boolean-captured-source.md

background_independent_source_rebind_202.scope: Remesh compares and validates independent canonical source on a worker, then rechecks lifecycle and scene before proof binding; Box stale/cancel/budget tests passed.
background_independent_source_rebind_202.limitations: Capture/admission and final scene preparation remain on caller; Document/Undo retain display. Cold restore, NativeBrep disposition, v5 and acceptance remain open.

shared_source_remesh_rebind_2026_11_13.scope: Attested immutable shared source/topology can rebind after placement without a repeated source scan or validation scratch; worker, busy, independent-owner fallback and history fixtures passed.
shared_source_remesh_rebind_2026_11_13.limitations: Independent source validation still runs on caller; Document/Undo retain display. Cold restore, v5, physical peak and desktop acceptance remain open.

attested_source_remesh_rebind_2026_11_13.scope: OCCT remesh rebinds previously native-attested canonical source and topology independently of a replacement display; it rejects changed topology, budget refusal and stale publication.
attested_source_remesh_rebind_2026_11_13.limitations: Lookup and source validation remain on caller; Document/Undo retain display. Arbitrary v4 and NativeBrep disposition, cold restore, v5 and desktop acceptance remain open.

proof_canonical_source_lease_2026_11_13.scope: Topology proof keeps an independently accounted immutable canonical source/topology lease; worker reuse and exact content matching are checked in product fixtures.
proof_canonical_source_lease_2026_11_13.limitations: Existing proof lookup/rebind still verifies document display; Document/Undo, source-only rebind, cold restore and v5 remain open.

current_remesh_profile_hit_2026_11_10.scope: Explicit remesh requests can reuse a matching current scene display after source, document, proof and profile checks, preserving the poll contract.
current_remesh_profile_hit_2026_11_10.limitations: Current-scene only; no document/Undo display eviction, multi-profile recovery, large-model timing, native/process peak or desktop evidence.

topology_proof_retired_branch_2026_11_06.scope: Original-document-only pruning was withdrawn because equivalent history documents can still retain the proof's source.
topology_proof_retired_branch_2026_11_06.limitations: Proof retention is conservative and optional; source-only document/Undo, display eviction, native peak and desktop remain open.

remesh_independent_leases_2026_11_06.scope: Remeshed pick display and render buffers retain independently admitted owners across scene snapshots.
remesh_independent_leases_2026_11_06.limitations: Document/Undo display eviction, native/process peak and desktop remain open.

remesh_scene_display_owner_2026_11_06.scope: Published remesh scenes retain accounted display/topology without keeping the candidate's duplicate source or descriptors.
remesh_scene_display_owner_2026_11_06.limitations: Original document/Undo display eviction, v4 attestation, native/process peaks and desktop remain open.

remesh_retained_reservation_2026_11_06.scope: Remesh worker releases unused kernel construction allowance while its candidate receipt remains charged through scene lifetime.
remesh_retained_reservation_2026_11_06.limitations: Envelope accounting is conservative; native/channel/process peaks, desktop and document/Undo display eviction remain open.

topology_proof_versions_undo_2026_11_06.scope: The reclaimable in-process proof cache distinguishes multiple geometry snapshots of one object and selects the current version after Undo/Redo.
topology_proof_versions_undo_2026_11_06.limitations: Proofs remain evictable and lookup is linear; document/Undo display eviction, long-history latency, native peak and desktop remain open.

sphere_production_topology_proof_2026_11.scope: Production Sphere attempts admitted native topology capture and transfers an optional proof to the shared reclaimable cache; opt-in controller remesh can use a surviving proof through Undo/Redo.
sphere_production_topology_proof_2026_11.limitations: No automatic remesh or document/Undo display eviction; proof may be lost, legacy v4 remains unattested, and native peak, desktop and production latency are unmeasured.

topology_source_binding_2026_11_06.scope: In-process remesh attestation checks a source/topology digest when capturing and consuming a source-only lease.
topology_source_binding_2026_11_06.limitations: This integrity binding is not native mapping attestation for legacy data; production Sphere, document/Undo display eviction, large-topology timing, native peak and desktop remain open.

topology_cache_insert_pressure_2026_11_0.scope: An existing topology-proof cache releases its mutex during shared-memory admission and rechecks slots after concurrent reclamation or insertion.
topology_cache_insert_pressure_2026_11_0.limitations: Experimental in-process cache only; production Sphere, document/Undo source-only ownership, native peak and desktop remain open.

sphere_snapshot_admission_2026_11_06.scope: Sphere's production primitive snapshot copy uses shared Rust memory admission and reserved transaction transfer.
sphere_snapshot_admission_2026_11_06.limitations: Native OCCT allocations and process peak are not bounded; source/display/Undo separation remains open.

shapeset_source_identity_2026_11_06.scope: Internally paired ShapeSet restore rereads and retains canonical source bytes while matching packet topology references before rebinding IDs.
shapeset_source_identity_2026_11_06.limitations: Fixture-scoped in-process path only; unsupported normalization is refused, and document/Undo ownership, native peak and desktop remain open.

staged_stl_shared_admission_2026_11_05.scope: Replace whole-headroom captured/Controller and detached STL leases with shared phase admission; add Rust native-source/snapshot copy hooks, preserve typed refusal and selection allocation phases
staged_stl_shared_admission_2026_11_05.limitations: Native conversion/meshing allocations precede copy callbacks and are not bounded by this admission. Topology/hash scratch stays estimated pending; full allocator/path/worker/receipt ownership, automatic eviction, UI background integration, release/desktop and the rest of P1-P5 remain open.

stl_export_no_display_edge_sampling_2026.scope: Omit viewport-only sampled edge polylines from export snapshots with topology bindings
stl_export_no_display_edge_sampling_2026.limitations: No release A/B memory peak or comprehensive geometry equivalence; other native allocations remain unbounded

multiedge_curved_loft_memory_2026_11_04.scope: Measure process high-water for 12-edge fillet and curved 32-section loft, with volume and closedness checks
multiedge_curved_loft_memory_2026_11_04.limitations: Synthetic process samples, not native allocation bounds; complex real models, native OOM and concurrent jobs remain open

stl_fan_adjacency_admission_2026_11_04.scope: Check known indexed fan adjacency and traversal capacities alongside retained fan lists
stl_fan_adjacency_admission_2026_11_04.limitations: Hash metadata, allocator, native and encoded-output allocations remain outside the lower bound

stl_vertex_fan_list_admission_2026_11_04.scope: Known fan-table and per-vertex link capacities are checked during indexed STL topology analysis; adjacency and encoded-output scratch remain open.

stl_edge_stage_admission_2026_11_04.scope: Check known indexed face and edge table capacities at growth boundaries
stl_edge_stage_admission_2026_11_04.limitations: Hash metadata, allocator peaks, fan and encoded-output stages remain outside this lower bound

stl_indexed_topology_minimum_2026_11_04.scope: Admit retained STL soup and minimum topology union-find arrays together
stl_indexed_topology_minimum_2026_11_04.limitations: Hash maps, fan scratch and encoded-output analysis remain outside the lower bound

stl_brep_amortized_growth_2026_11_04.scope: Plan B-rep output growth with amortized capacity and combined exact fallback
stl_brep_amortized_growth_2026_11_04.limitations: Allocator, topology and native transient peaks remain incomplete

stl_authored_mesh_growth_admission_2026_.scope: Preflight authored STL mesh buffer growth with amortized capacity and exact-size fallback
stl_authored_mesh_growth_admission_2026_.limitations: Allocator, topology diagnostics and native transient peaks remain incomplete

stl_brep_output_growth_admission_2026_11.scope: Preflight old and new STL B-rep output buffers with source and remap retained
stl_brep_output_growth_admission_2026_11.limitations: Authored-mesh growth, allocator and native transient peaks remain incomplete

stl_topology_lookup_estimate_2026_11_04.scope: Include conservative remap lookup-tree estimates in STL admission
stl_topology_lookup_estimate_2026_11_04.limitations: Allocator, output growth and native transient peaks remain incomplete

stl_topology_remap_minimum_2026_11_04.scope: Admit snapshot and minimum remap arrays together in STL
stl_topology_remap_minimum_2026_11_04.limitations: Lookup maps, output growth and native/allocator transients are not bounded

stl_soup_snapshot_admission_2026_11_04.scope: Deduct existing STL soup and temporary source capacities before native snapshot admission
stl_soup_snapshot_admission_2026_11_04.limitations: Native, remap and output-growth peaks remain outside complete admission

stl_worker_snapshot_reservation_cap_2026.scope: Cap experimental STL worker snapshot admission at its reservation
stl_worker_snapshot_reservation_cap_2026.limitations: Does not bound native mesher transients or concurrent export scratch

grouped_topology_copy_admission_2026_11_.scope: Admit retained Rust snapshot and grouped topology arrays in one synchronous callback account
grouped_topology_copy_admission_2026_11_.limitations: Native, allocator and validation peaks remain outside this account

occt_snapshot_copy_preflight_2026_11_04.scope: Check aggregate minimum Rust snapshot buffer size before copying native snapshot arrays
occt_snapshot_copy_preflight_2026_11_04.limitations: Native buffers, grouped bindings, validation scratch and allocator peaks remain unaccounted

kernel_operation_memory_probe_2026_11_04.scope: Measure isolated process high-water for simple Boolean, Fillet and Loft fixtures
kernel_operation_memory_probe_2026_11_04.limitations: Synthetic process-wide high-water is not a native upper bound or admission envelope

nurbs_ray_miss_2026_11_03.scope: Distinguish a completed NURBS ray miss from invalid inputs and native failure while preserving legacy error-on-miss callers.
nurbs_ray_miss_2026_11_03.limitations: Synthetic candidate; general ambiguous intersections, native memory and desktop evidence remain open.

fixed_face_ray_output_2026_11_03.scope: Expose bounded inline face-ray results while retaining the existing vector wrapper; UI and experimental worker avoid point/group-result heap vectors.
fixed_face_ray_output_2026_11_03.limitations: Other Rust allocations and OCCT native peak remain outside a complete admission bound; desktop remains unverified.

bounded_face_ray_groups_2026_11_03.scope: Bounded synchronous OCCT adapter reconstructs a call-local B-rep once for up to eight ordered face-ray intersections; Rust owns identities, output and worker lifecycle.
bounded_face_ray_groups_2026_11_03.limitations: Worker and synchronous UI use; no global native allocation bound, desktop acceptance or complete topology coverage.

sdk_integration_plan.scope_rule: All SDK-eligible child L3 are delivered with their public adapter; host-internal/governance work records an explicit reason instead of exposing private state.

baseline.qualification: Planning baseline only; source presence and runtime metadata are not new execution evidence.

sdk_integration_plan.owner_specific_task: Bọc selected BRep service, audit linked operations; từ chối fixture probes; Mac theo portability và packaging theo target.
tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.
